title: Proxmox node
description: One PVE node in depth: CPU, load, memory, swap, root disk, NICs, its guests and storages.

list.name: cluster
list.label: Cluster
list.description: The lylat cluster (every node but greatfox) or the standalone greatfox.

panels.title: State
panels.description: UP if the node reported within the last minute of the time range.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Busy share of all cores.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Used = total - available.

panels.title: Root FS
panels.description: The node's root filesystem (local storage lives on it).

panels.title: Load / core
panels.description: Load averages divided by the cores; above 1 means tasks wait for a CPU.

panels.title: Guests
panels.description: On this node now: running VMs and CTs, stopped guests (templates not counted), templates.

targets.expr: count(pvestatd_system_running{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"} == 0 unless on (object, vmid, nodename) pvestatd_system_template{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: node_exporter
panels.description: Prometheus node_exporter on this node; click for Node Exporter Full (hardware, disks, temperatures).

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Busy share of all cores, and the share spent waiting for I/O.

panels.title: Load average
panels.description: 1, 5 and 15 minute load averages; the dashed line is the node's core count.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Used (total - available) and available stack up to the total. ZFS ARC shows only on nodes with ZFS.

panels.title: Root filesystem
panels.description: Used share of /, as df reports it.

panels.title: Physical NICs
panels.description: Every physical NIC; inbound up, outbound down.

panels.title: Bridges and bonds
panels.description: Linux bridges (guest traffic and VLANs) and bonds.

panels.title: Interfaces
panels.description: Physical NICs, bonds, bridges and VLAN interfaces (guest tap/veth and firewall bridges left out). Totals are bytes since the node booted. Type follows PVE's rule for physical NIC names.

panels.title: Guests
panels.description: Now (end of the time range). Memory is what the guest uses on the host (VM: memhost, CT: mem); Configured is its maximum. CPU is the share of its own vCPUs. Click a name for the guest's dashboard.

targets.expr: max by (vmid, host, object, nodename, tags) (pvestatd_system_running{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"})
max by (vmid, host, object, nodename, tags) (pvestatd_system_uptime{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"})
max by (vmid, host, object, nodename, tags) (pvestatd_system_cpus{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"})
max by (vmid, host, object, nodename, tags) (pvestatd_system_cpu{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"})
max by (vmid, host, object, nodename, tags) ((pvestatd_system_memhost{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"} or pvestatd_system_mem{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"}))
max by (vmid, host, object, nodename, tags) (pvestatd_system_maxmem{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"})

max by (vmid, host, object, nodename, tags) ((pvestatd_system_memhost{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"} or pvestatd_system_mem{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"}) / (pvestatd_system_maxmem{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"} > 0))
max by (vmid, host, object, nodename, tags) (pvestatd_system_maxdisk{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"})
max by (vmid, host, object, nodename, tags) (rate(pvestatd_system_diskread{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"}[$__rate_interval]))
max by (vmid, host, object, nodename, tags) (rate(pvestatd_system_diskwrite{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"}[$__rate_interval]))
max by (vmid, host, object, nodename, tags) (rate(pvestatd_system_netin{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8)
max by (vmid, host, object, nodename, tags) (rate(pvestatd_system_netout{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8)

panels.title: Guest CPU (cores)
panels.description: Cores each guest keeps busy (CPU share x vCPUs), stacked.

targets.expr: max by (host, vmid) (pvestatd_system_cpu{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"} * pvestatd_system_cpus{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"}) > 0

panels.title: Guest memory (host)
panels.description: Host memory each guest uses (VM: memhost, CT: mem), stacked.

targets.expr: max by (host, vmid) (pvestatd_system_memhost{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"} or pvestatd_system_mem{object=~"qemu|lxc", nodename="$node"}) > 0

panels.title: Guest disk I/O
panels.description: Read + write per guest, stacked.

panels.title: Guest network
panels.description: In + out per guest, stacked.

panels.title: Storage used
panels.description: Used / total. Shared storages once, local ones per node.

targets.expr: max by (storage) (label_replace(max by (host) ((max by (host, nodename) (pvestatd_system_used{object="storages", nodename="$node"}) / (max by (host, nodename) (pvestatd_system_total{object="storages", nodename="$node"}) > 0)) and on (host, nodename) (max by (host, nodename) (pvestatd_system_shared{object="storages", nodename="$node"}) == 1)), "storage", "$1", "host", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_join((max by (host, nodename) (pvestatd_system_used{object="storages", nodename="$node"}) / (max by (host, nodename) (pvestatd_system_total{object="storages", nodename="$node"}) > 0)) and on (host, nodename) (max by (host, nodename) (pvestatd_system_shared{object="storages", nodename="$node"}) == 0), "storage", " (", "host", "nodename"), "storage", "$1)", "storage", "(.+)"))

panels.title: Storages
panels.description: Now, shared storages once. Growth is the change of used space over the time range, per day; Full in extrapolates it ("not filling up" when not growing). Click a storage: Ceph storages open the Ceph cluster dashboard, local ones their node.
